/bin/bash -lc 'npm test && (node src/server.js >/tmp/activity-service.log 2>&1 & svc=$!; trap '"'kill "'$svc'"' EXIT; sleep 0.3; curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/ >/tmp/activity-home.html; curl -fsS -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/schedules -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'x-account-id: acct-smoke' -d '{\"frequency\":\"daily\",\"destination\":\"https://hooks.example.test/report\",\"nextRunAt\":\"2026-08-14T00:00:00Z\"}' >/tmp/activity-create.json; curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/api/schedules -H 'x-account-id: acct-smoke'; echo; test -s /tmp/activity-home.html; test -s /tmp/activity-create.json)"
